title: Instagram Brand Ambassador Programs: How They Work and How to Join (2026)
excerpt: What an Instagram brand ambassador does, how ambassador programs pay (product, commission or fee), how to find programs in your niche and how to get accepted.
content:
What is a brand ambassador on Instagram?

Quick answer: a brand ambassador is a creator who promotes one brand over a longer period, usually months, instead of a single sponsored post. In return they get free product, a commission on sales through their code, a monthly fee, or a mix. Many brands run ambassador programs that small creators can apply to through an application form on the brand's website or through an affiliate platform.

What do Instagram brand ambassadors get?

  • Free product, often sent regularly or with each launch;
  • Commission on sales through a personal discount code or link;
  • A fee per month or per piece of content, mostly for established ambassadors;
  • Perks like early access, events or features on the brand's account.

Read the terms before you join: some programs ask you to post a set number of times a month, or to avoid competing brands.

Types of ambassador programs

TypeHow it worksBest for
Open applicationApply on the brand's website; approved creators get a code and perksSmall creators getting started
Affiliate-ledJoin through an affiliate platform and earn commission on salesCreators who post product recommendations
Invite-onlyThe brand picks creators who already post about itCreators with a strong niche presence
Paid ambassadorA contract with a monthly fee and fixed deliverablesExperienced creators with proven results

How to find brands looking for ambassadors

  • Brand websites: look for "Ambassador", "Affiliate", "Creators" or "Collab" in the footer, or search "[brand] ambassador program".
  • Instagram: brands often post ambassador calls in Stories and highlights; creators in your niche tag the brands they represent.
  • Affiliate platforms: many ambassador programs run through affiliate networks where you can browse and apply.
  • Brand directories: lists of brands open to creator collaborations, such as Newcollab's brand directory.

Start with brands you already use and post about. Programs accept creators whose content already fits the brand far more often.

How to get accepted

  1. Post about the brand first (honestly, and tagged) so they can see the fit.
  2. Keep your profile focused on one niche with a clear bio and contact email.
  3. In the application or email, say how you'd feature the product, link two of your best posts, and share one real number such as average Reel views.
  4. Follow up once if you haven't heard back in a week or two.

Is being a brand ambassador worth it?

Often, yes, if the brand fits your content and the terms are fair. Ambassador programs give steadier income than one-off deals and build a long-term relationship. Watch out for programs that ask you to buy product to join, or that lock you into exclusivity for little in return.

Do brand ambassadors have to disclose?

Yes. Use Instagram's Paid partnership label or a clear disclosure like #ad or #ambassador whenever you post about the brand, including when you were given free product. In the US the FTC expects this for any material connection.

Pitch the brands you want to work with

Not every brand advertises a program, and many will start a partnership with a creator who pitches a clear idea. Polly, Newcollab's AI assistant, finds brands in your niche with a working contact and writes each pitch for that brand's product.

faq.question: How do I become a brand ambassador on Instagram?
faq.answer: Post honestly about brands you already use, keep your profile focused on one niche, then apply through the brand's ambassador or affiliate page or email them with a specific idea and links to your best posts.

faq.question: Do brand ambassadors get paid?
faq.answer: It depends on the program. Many start with free product and a commission on sales through a personal code; established ambassadors can earn a monthly fee for fixed deliverables.

faq.question: How many followers do you need to be a brand ambassador?
faq.answer: Many open ambassador programs accept small creators, as long as the content fits the brand and the audience is engaged. Paid ambassador roles usually expect more reach and proven results.

faq.question: What is the difference between a brand ambassador and an influencer?
faq.answer: An influencer deal is often a single sponsored post. A brand ambassador promotes one brand over a longer period, usually with ongoing perks, commission or a fee.

faq.question: Are ambassador programs that ask you to buy product legit?
faq.answer: Be cautious. Legitimate programs send product or pay commission. Programs that require you to buy products to join are usually sales schemes rather than real partnerships.
